support_claim: The evidence links billing activity and a shared counterparty name to MSA-MER-2024, but no proposition establishes that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote the same legal counterparty, nor that they are distinct.

propositions.proposition: Meridian Energy Partners invoices are described as the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
propositions.relevance: Associates billing activity for Meridian Energy Partners with contract MSA-MER-2024, but does not establish that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: The billed name on record is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent as a billing-side entity name; does not by itself establish identity with the right referent.

propositions.proposition: MSA-MER-2024 lists Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
propositions.relevance: Names a counterparty on the agreement referenced by contract:MSA-MER-2024; shared name with the billing referent is compatibility, not establishing evidence of referent identity.
